parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is offering 1 Wood for 1 Wheat. Looking at my resources, I have 3 Wood and only 1 Wheat. I am already overflowing with Wood and Wheat is scarce for me, especially since Claude just blocked my primary Wheat source (Hex 14, Wheat 9) with the robber. Accepting this would give me more of what I already have too much of and take away my last piece of a resource I desperately need to build my next settlement at N23. Claude is clearly desperate for Wheat (Gemma just rejected him too). There is no strategic reason to help him while hurting my own balance.
parsed.note_to_self: Claude is aggressively seeking Wheat after blocking my Wheat 9. I should hold onto my Wheat and look for a way to move the robber or trade for Brick.
parsed.say_outloud: קלוד, אתה רציני? חסמת לי את ה-9 חיטה ועכשיו אתה רוצה לקחת לי את החיטה האחרונה שנשארה לי בשביל עוד עץ? יש לי מספיק עץ לבנות יער שלם, אני לא נוגע בעסקה הזאת.
